retrieval: GitHub connector github_fetch, exact /git/commits/{sha} then /git/trees/{tree_sha}?recursive=1; no shell network requests.
method: For every cached non-generated file, compare SHA1(b"blob "+ASCII(byte_length)+b"\0"+bytes) with exact upstream Git tree blob. Map Cargo.toml.orig to upstream Cargo.toml. Compare every cached file SHA256 with both the actual compiled vendor copy and BUILD_ATTEMPT03 source_files, and recompute the sorted inventory SHA256.
limitations: The seven original .crate archives are absent; published archive SHA256 remains unverified, even though all source Git blobs match.
Cargo normalized manifests receive explicit semantic checks, not a byte-for-byte reconstruction of their published packaging representation.
Cargo.lock and extraction metadata are pinned to the actual build but excluded from raw upstream Git comparison as generated packaging files.
This verifies equality with upstream repository commits served by GitHub; it is not a publisher signature, toolchain attestation, or dependency behavior audit.

normalized_manifest.claim_scope: Semantic check of build-relevant normalized fields; not reconstruction of the published normalized TOML bytes or crate archive.
